idle_1.desc: idle pose standing, gentle breathing in, arms relaxed at sides, calm face

idle_2.desc: idle pose standing, breathing neutral, arms relaxed, subtle sway

idle_3.desc: idle pose standing, gentle breathing out, arms relaxed, calm face

attack_1.desc: attack frame 1/4: drawing the bow, arrow nocked, arms pulling back, body steady

attack_2.desc: attack frame 2/4: fully drawn, aiming, focused, slight lean forward

attack_3.desc: attack frame 3/4: arrow released, bow snapping forward, follow-through

attack_4.desc: attack frame 4/4: recovery, bow returning to rest, body settling

hurt_1.desc: hurt frame 1/3: hit impact, leaning back, arms flinching, surprised face

hurt_2.desc: hurt frame 2/3: recoiling backward, off balance, guard up

hurt_3.desc: hurt frame 3/3: recovering stance, returning to standing

walk_1.desc: walk cycle frame 1/6 CONTACT: front foot planted on ground, rear foot lifting, slight forward lean

walk_2.desc: walk cycle frame 2/6 DOWN: body lowest point, legs passing each other, arms mid-swing

walk_3.desc: walk cycle frame 3/6 RECOIL: rear leg pushing off, front leg beginning to swing forward

walk_4.desc: walk cycle frame 4/6 PASSING: legs crossing, body at highest point, arms swinging

walk_5.desc: walk cycle frame 5/6 UP: front foot lifting, rear leg straightening, arms at swing extreme

walk_6.desc: walk cycle frame 6/6 LAND: front foot coming down to contact, body balanced
